proposals.before: When the Last Emperor took the throne, he became prefect of Pu, then of Cao.

proposals.before: When the Last Emperor acceded, he was moved to prefect of Pu, then transferred to prefect of Cao.
proposals.after: When the Last Emperor acceded, he was moved to prefect of Pu, then transferred to prefect of Chan.

proposals.before: Jin took Cao Prefecture, carried Yanzhang’s family to Taiyuan, gave them a mansion and rich provision, and sent envoys now and then to win him over. Yanzhang killed every envoy and broke for good.
proposals.after: Jin took Chan Prefecture, carried Yanzhang’s family to Taiyuan, gave them a mansion and rich provision, and sent envoys now and then to win him over. Yanzhang killed every envoy and broke for good.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chan/Danzhou, not Cao; same error as in s0009.

proposals.before: The Jin army took Cao Prefecture, carried off Yanzhang’s wife and children to Taiyuan, granted them a mansion, and supplied them generously. From time to time they sent envoys to win Yanzhang over; Yanzhang executed the envoys to cut himself off.
proposals.after: The Jin army took Chan Prefecture, carried off Yanzhang’s wife and children to Taiyuan, granted them a mansion, and supplied them generously. From time to time they sent envoys to win Yanzhang over; Yanzhang executed the envoys to cut himself off.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chan/Danzhou, not Cao; same error as in s0009.

proposals.before: He then made Renzhan Acting Grand Preceptor of War, Central Secretariat Director, and Military Governor of Pingyi.
proposals.after: He then made Renzhan Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Military Governor of the Tianping Army.
proposals.reason: 太尉 is Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor of War (太師); 天平軍 is the Tianping Army, not Pingyi.

decisions.reason: Chinese annotation brackets 〈〉 enclose the parenthetical note; English already uses ASCII parentheses, so the leftover fullwidth 〉 is a stray artifact with no semantic role.
Same stray fullwidth 〉 as in the idiomatic field; the Chinese closes with annotation bracket 〉 already mirrored by English ), so removing the leftover character is correct.
Focus unit has 澶州刺史; 澶 is Chan (Danzhou), whereas Cao would be 曹. Replacing Cao with Chan restores the prefecture correctly.
Literal likewise mistranslates 澶州 as Cao; Chan matches 澶 and distinguishes it from 曹州.
晉軍攻破澶州 names Chan Prefecture again; Cao is the wrong place-name and the rest of the sentence is otherwise faithful.
Literal repeats the 澶州→Cao error; Chan is the accurate English for 澶州 and leaves the capture and embassy wording intact.
檢校太尉兼中書令 is Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat (太尉≠太師); 天平軍節度使 is Military Governor of the Tianping Army, not Pingyi.
